title: Karnataka Vajpayee Arogyashree – legacy name Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Former Karnataka health assurance programme for eligible low-income beneficiaries, now associated with the state's integrated health assurance framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Historical eligibility depended on Karnataka beneficiary categories; current applicants should use the active state programme.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Karnataka Vajpayee Arogyashree – legacy name.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
